leverage.exposure: This is the item that outranks everything. A negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday, and that is the default outcome if Georg does nothing at all, because the auction resolves in his favour on its own. The exposure has now been carried across four runs without being closed. It can be closed in two ways and the choice depends only on whether he can act between the auction resolving and the lock. If he can, he should wait and sell immediately after the bid lands, which preserves points in the branch where he is outbid. If he cannot, he should sell now and accept a smaller expected loss in exchange for eliminating the tail. A new risk raised the stakes on the tail this run: one rival liquidated three players back to the market inside ten minutes and now holds enough cash to beat an offer that sits only modestly above market value. That lowers the chance the bid lands. It is not a reason to raise the offer, and not a reason to withdraw it, but it is a reason to take the failure branches seriously rather than assuming the player is already won.

binding_gap: There is no binding formation gap. The squad fills its best shape today and fills it again after the intended swap, so nothing here is about covering a hole. The gap that binds is cash, not shape: the live offer exceeds the balance, and closing that shortfall is the whole task. Only one squad player is worth enough on his own to close it, which is what removes the choice of funding leg.

verdict.headline: The leveraged Makengo position is open and unfunded for the fourth consecutive run, and it is still the only thing that matters.
verdict.headline_short: The leveraged Makengo position is open and unfunded for the fourth con
verdict.detail: The leveraged Makengo position is open and unfunded for the fourth consecutive run, and it is still the only thing that matters. The auction resolves this afternoon, roughly two hours before the MD2 lock, and Georg's offer is the only one on the listing, so it wins unless someone outbids him. If it lands and the balance is still negative at the lock, the entire matchday scores zero. This run does not change the recommended trade, but it does change the framing that four previous runs used, and Georg should read the change: selling Bernardo pre-emptively is NOT free. It is insurance, and this briefing prices it. The decision now reduces to a single question about Georg's own availability this evening, and the briefing puts that question to him rather than pretending the answer is obvious.

sell.reason: Bernardo is the funding leg, and he is the only one that works. He is also a fit, confirmed starter, now backed by a third dated preview that is newer than any source the ledger previously held, so this is a starter-for-starter quality swap and not the disposal of a benched man that earlier runs described. The Kickbase fitness flag still sitting on him is stale by nearly four days and is contradicted by every current source; it is not news and should not be acted on. The genuinely new point is the ordering. Selling him before the auction resolves guarantees the position is funded and needs nothing further from Georg, but it surrenders real points in the branch where the bid is beaten, because he cannot be replaced afterwards. Waiting until the auction resolves and selling him only if it lands preserves those points, but requires Georg to act in a short window on a Friday evening. The first is worth slightly less on expectation; the second is catastrophic if he is unreachable. Amoako remains sellable at no cost to the fielded eleven, but only in the waiting branch, and never alongside a pre-sale of Bernardo, because two sales before the auction resolves would drop the squad below the minimum and invite a penalty on top of a lost auction.

standing.name: Bernardo - CONDITIONAL, only after Makengo lands, never before
standing.why: THE ORDER IS THE WHOLE CALL. Sell him ONLY in the window after the Makengo auction resolves in Georg's favour (~16:32Z) and before the lock (18:30Z). Selling him earlier is the trap: squad is 12, SELL S6x53gy takes it to 11, and a second pre-sale takes it to 10 = the -100 penalty if the auction is then lost, which costs 162 points against holding. Conversely, if Makengo lands and Bernardo is NOT sold, cash is -3.273.942 at the lock and the matchday scores ZERO. WHY HIM AND NOT SOMEONE CHEAPER - this is arithmetic, not preference. After Makengo the squad is 13 = 1GK/6DEF/4MID/2ATT; Amoako takes it to 12 and exactly one more sale is possible before hitting 10. That sale MUST be a defender (selling a MID leaves 2 and no legal shape; selling an ATT leaves 1; selling the GK leaves 0) and it must raise at least 3.273.942. Widmer is the lowest-ap defender at 29 but his mv is only 1.833.175 - he does NOT close the gap, and Amoako+Widmer together leave cash at -1.440.767, still negative, still ZERO. So the second leg is the cheapest defender above the threshold, and by ap that is Bernardo at 62 (next are Minjae 110, Matsima 138, ter Horst 143). Resulting eleven 5-3-2: Baumann 129; Matsima 138, Widmer 29, Minjae 110, ter Horst 143, Makengo 90; Nusa 226, Lokonga 44, Onyeka 139; Gregoritsch 195, Guirassy 180 = 1423 fielded ap vs 1395 today, +28, with cash +3.882.160. THIS IS NOT AN AVAILABILITY SALE AND THE BRIEFING MUST NOT PRETEND IT IS. Kickbase shows st 2 / stl [2] on him, but the news refutes the flag: his only real issue was a minor Achilles complaint reported 22.08.2026 (Ilzer), Ligainsider published "Bernardo meldet sich fuer Koeln zurueck" on 28.08.2026, his profile shows the green Fit icon, and three previews dated 03.09.2026 (Comunio, Yahoo, TheHardTackle) all start him at left-back v Dortmund with Hoffenheim's only absentees Prass and Asllani. He is a fit confirmed starter being sold for cash and a better slot. Reject on sight: ligainsider "Bernardo fehlt verletzungsbedingt im TSG-Kader" is 08.02.2026, last season.

standing.name: Bernardo - THE DECISION RULE, keyed to one question: can Georg act 16:33-18:30Z?
standing.why:
REPLACES THE CONTRADICTORY PAIR Su3g5z2 (closed, "sell now unconditionally") AND SUPPLIES THE PRECONDITION Suill11 (still open, "sell only after Makengo lands") never stated. READ THIS INSTEAD OF RE-DERIVING THE BRANCHES.

THE WHOLE DECISION REDUCES TO ONE QUESTION: can Georg act in the 1h57m between the Makengo auction resolving (~2026-09-04T16:33Z) and the MD2 lock (18:30Z)? That is 18:33-20:30 CEST on a Friday evening. Everything else is settled.

IF YES - THE BETTER BRANCH, and it is Suill11: do nothing now. When Makengo lands at ~16:33Z the balance goes to -4.812.478; sell Bernardo back to Kickbase at that moment for 7.156.102 and cash is +2.343.624, squad 12 at 1GK/5DEF/4MID/2ATT, 5-3-2 optimal, fielded XI 1423. If instead he is OUTBID, sell nothing and keep 1395. Outcome 1423 or 1395.

IF NO - THE INSURANCE BRANCH: sell Bernardo NOW, on sight. Cash becomes 11.343.624 and the position is funded whatever happens; if Makengo lands, cash 2.343.624 and XI 1423 with no further action required. THE COST IS REAL AND MUST BE STATED: if he is outbid, the squad sits at 11 (1GK/4DEF/4MID/2ATT), only 4-4-2 is legal, Amoako is forced in at ap 0, and the eleven is 1333 - 62 points worse than holding, and unrecoverable because Makengo is the LAST pre-lock resolver on the board. Outcome 1423 or 1333.

THE ASYMMETRY THAT MAKES THIS EASY TO GET WRONG: the waiting branch is worth only about 9-16 expected points more than the insurance branch, but FAILING to act in the window is worth about MINUS 1210 - a negative balance at matchday start scores ZERO for the entire matchday. So do not choose the waiting branch on the strength of its 9-16 points unless the 16:33-18:30Z availability is genuinely certain. When in doubt, take the insurance.

WHAT MUST NOT BE DONE, IN EITHER BRANCH: do not pre-sell BOTH Amoako and Bernardo. Two pre-sales take the squad from 12 to 10, and fewer than 11 players is a -100 penalty on top of losing the auction. SELL S6x53gy (Amoako) is therefore compatible ONLY with the waiting branch, where it banks 1.618.536 of a decaying asset (tfhmvt -90.911/day) at zero fielded-points cost and cuts the gap to 3.193.942 - it is not required, it only shrinks the action needed in the window.

DO NOT RAISE THE MAKENGO BID in either branch - see HOLD Hkyt9gf. ofc is still 1 with ofs [Georg Kitz] only; raising against yourself is the Onyeka error that cost ~4,5M. NEW RISK THIS RUN, recorded in HOLD H08gr86: David raised 27.785.290 in ten minutes at 06:05-06:15Z by dumping Raab, El-Faouzi and Jatta back to Kickbase at mv, so a rival now has the cash to beat a bid that sits only +13,03% over mv. That lowers the probability the bid lands - it is a reason to weight the failure branches more heavily, not a reason to raise or to withdraw.

BERNARDO IS A FIT CONFIRMED STARTER AND THIS IS A QUALITY SWAP, NOT A DISPOSAL: ap 62 out for ap 90 in, +28 nominal and less on expectation since both are one-match figures per Hp0rkuf and Makengo carries genuine rotation risk against captain Guenter (read him at 70-85% to start). Three dated sources now start Bernardo at left-back v Dortmund - Comunio 03.09, Yahoo 03.09, Sports Mole 04.09 - and Hoffenheim's only doubts are Prass and Asllani. His Kickbase st 2 / stxt "Stricken - does not come through KOE (A) unscathed" is dt 2026-08-31T14:40:12Z, now 88h old and unchanged while the provider demonstrably refreshes other flags. It is stale data, not a live injury. DO NOT push-notify on it.

standing.name: Amoako
standing.why: REVERSES HOLD Hdcmr4g ("hold through the lock"), now closed. Say this out loud in the briefing. Hdcmr4g was reasoning about RELISTING him to a manager, where his lapsed 1.850.000 ask (+8,22%) sat above the manager cluster ceiling and would lapse again. That is still true and irrelevant: the sale that matters is back to KICKBASE at exactly mv, which is instant and certain (this run measured it four times - Seimen 6.278.094, Fabio Silva 7.928.365, Mueller 2.122.368, Nandja 3.265.757, all sold to the market at mv to the euro). WHY NOW AND NOT AFTER THE LOCK: Georg has a live 9.000.000 offer on Makengo against cash 4.107.522, a gap of 4.892.478 that must be closed inside the 1h58m between the auction resolving (~16:32Z) and the lock (18:30Z) or the whole matchday scores ZERO. Selling Amoako now cuts that gap to 3.273.942 and turns a two-action scramble into a one-action one. IT COSTS NOTHING: he is the only squad player with no Kickbase points record at all, he is not in the eleven (no lo), and at 12 players the best shape is 5-3-2 which drops him anyway - fielded ap stays 1395 either way. He is also decaying: mv fell from 1.709.447 to 1.618.536 since the last run, exactly -90.911 = his tfhmvt, which independently confirms the Hds9v3o finding that tfhmvt is the daily tick and sdmvt is the seven-day sum. AFTER THE SALE the squad is 11 = 1GK/5DEF/3MID/2ATT with exactly one legal shape (5-3-2) and no spare body, which is Hxncgeb's warning and is accepted deliberately: 11 is not a penalty, only fewer than 11 is. DO NOT also pre-sell Bernardo - see SELL S-Bernardo this run; two pre-sales put him at 10 and a -100 if the auction is lost.

buy.reason: Nothing new to buy, for the fifth consecutive run, and the reason is structural rather than a matter of taste. Recomputing every listing's resolution time against the lock leaves only a handful that settle before Georg is committed, and of those only Makengo improves the eleven; the rest are at or below the weakest man already in it, carry a fitness flag, or have no points record at all. Everything genuinely attractive on the board settles after the lock and therefore cannot score this matchday. The best points-per-euro listing on the whole board appeared this run, a Koeln attacker at exactly market value, and he is still useless here: he resolves well after the lock and could not enter the eleven anyway behind two better attackers. A Dortmund midfielder also appeared cheap and carries both a Kickbase fitness flag and an independent injury-table entry, which is exactly the trap the ledger has been logging all week. One rival cut his asking price to the thinnest premium yet seen and it changes nothing, because the player was rejected on points per euro, not on price. Do not raise the Makengo bid. Georg is the sole bidder, and bidding against yourself on an uncontested listing is the error that has already cost this team several million once.
